topic: Network Quality Impact on Sales Conversation

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Derek, before we talk about any upgrades, I need to address the performance issues we've been having. Our warehouse management system has been sluggish for weeks.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're absolutely right to bring that up first. I've been monitoring your connection and I see the latency spikes. Let me explain what we've found and our plan to fix it before we discuss any expansion.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good, because honestly, it's hard to trust recommendations for more services when current ones aren't working properly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand that perspective. Trust is earned, not given. We've identified routing issues and implemented fixes yesterday. I'll show you the performance data and only discuss upgrades once you're satisfied with current service.
